column5: The shared shell foundation centralizes tag and PID ownership, bounded process termination, persistent stock-MySQL result framing, PD leader observation, event correlation, diagnostics, and cleanup used by the Campaign 22, 23, and 24 real-PD/TiKV proofs. Embedded self-tests cover zero and nonzero client-line accounting, exact row matching, tag ownership, endpoint parsing, absent-process cleanup, TERM-resistant owned supervisors, and rejection of unowned supervisors without starting TiUP. Campaign 24 then exercised the extracted lifecycle against a live three-PD/three-TiKV cluster and passed exact range, topology, blocked-query shutdown, and tag-owned cleanup assertions. The broader RealTiKV test lifecycle, SQL semantics, plan evidence, failpoint setup, and general store/domain behavior remain open and scenario-owned.
